title: Sugar Maple: Great Sugar Maples You Can Visit
meta_description: Ontario's Comfort Maple is widely reckoned the oldest sugar maple in Canada, at 400 to 500 years. Three more grow in Seattle and Chicago.
intro: Sugar maple is the maple of eastern North America and of the Canadian emblem, and the tree behind maple syrup and much of New England's autumn. Its great specimens are mostly a story of size and survival. In Ontario the Comfort Maple is widely reckoned the oldest of its kind in Canada, put at 400 to 500 years by the Ontario Forestry Association, about six metres round and held up in places by guy wires. Chicago's forest preserves hold two of the species, one 36.6 metres tall in Busse Forest South and a champion in Dam No. 1 Woods East. In Seattle a sugar maple 4.6 metres around stands on a Capitol Hill street, a long way from its native woods.
